t_advice_summary_textbox.text: start off by selecting a colour of gnome and pay attention to how many mushrooms it gives and you can start to form a pattern. sometimes the colours of the gnomes swap so sometimes gnomes that gave a lot of points will give little.

vb_textbox.text: you will be shown two gnomes, they will be two different colours. one colour will give you more mushrooms. start by selecting a colour and paying attention to how many mushrooms it gives you. you should be able to spot a pattern. pay attention, sometimes the colours swap, meaning that high mushroom giving colours are now low mushroom giving.
